title: Intermittent incidents and rear passenger comments
summary: This topic combines intermittent incident reports phrased around something having happened with a separate comfort comment about rear passenger space, so the examples do not form a single coherent issue.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention improved rear passenger room and one case described as infrequent rather than daily.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on dissatisfaction with escalation handling and one problem reference despite it not recurring.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly describe isolated or repeated events without enough detail to judge sentiment, including one-off incidents, recurrence counts, safety concern wording, a rear passenger tire mention, and a request to raise the controller height.

limitations: The topic is lexically driven by words like 'happened' and 'raised,' which pulls together unrelated subjects rather than one clear product theme.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined and provide too little context to identify the underlying system, feature, or failure mode.
Several examples are partial statements about an event recurring or not recurring, which limits precise interpretation.
